blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — RK Medino, a 17-year-old incoming UAAP rookie, got his full-circle moment when he led National University past VNS Laticrete–the club that discovered him–in the 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference. Medino delivered 15 points for NU-Archipelago Builders in their 25-14, 25-13, 20-25, 25-12 win over VNS on Tuesday at Mall of Asia Arena. “I’m grateful to the Spikers’ Turf, of course, and to our team, NU, as well as VNS, my former team. They played well, and we did, too,” said Medino in Filipino. “We also listened to our coaches and followed their instructions, especially when it came to […]...
